parameters.content:
## 1. Configure this run
Edit **Config** by hand before every execution. One county + one size category per run.

| code | county |
| --- | --- |
| 12 | Brodsko-posavska |
| 16 | Vukovarsko-srijemska |
| 4 | Karlovačka |
| 3 | Sisačko-moslavačka |
| 9 | Ličko-senjska |
| 13 | Zadarska |
| 15 | Šibensko-kninska |
| 17 | Splitsko-dalmatinska |
| 19 | Dubrovačko-neretvanska |
| 7 | Bjelovarsko-bilogorska |
| 11 | Požeško-slavonska |
| 1 | Zagrebačka |

**Micro** = employees 1–10, revenue 0–2,000,000 EUR
**Malo** = employees 11–49, revenue 2,000,000–10,000,000 EUR

`test_mode = true` stops after page 2.

## 2. Search pagination loop
Builds the companywall search URL for the current page, waits 3s, scrapes it through ScrapingBee.

**Empty page 1** → retried once with `render_js=true` (reCAPTCHA / session-cookie gate).
**Empty page 2+** → pagination is done, run ends.
**Failed page** (after 2 retries) → logged and skipped, run continues on the next page.

## 3. Per-company enrichment
One company at a time (batch size 1): wait 3s → scrape its profile → add owner/director, email, founding date, NKD, MBS onto the **same item**.

⚠️ **Profile selectors are unverified** — see README.md. They match on Croatian label text via XPath, with a page-text fallback. Check the first test run and adjust `extract_rules` on **Fetch Company Profile** if columns come back blank.

A failed profile fetch still writes the row, with the profile columns blank.

## 4. Dedupe + write
Looks up **OIB** in the `Raw Leads` tab. Already there → skip and log. Not there → append one row.

Employees and revenue are written as raw Croatian text (`cellFormat: RAW`); no number parsing anywhere in this workflow.

The `Selected` tab is never touched — the user copies chosen rows there by hand.
